147	class FleetSimulator:
148	    def __init__(self, grid: GridMap, robots: list[Robot], tasks: list[Task]) -> None:
149	        self.grid = grid
150	        # The map as built before any runtime edit; map-change history is
151	        # replayed against this baseline.
152	        self.base_grid = grid
153	        self.robots = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
154	        self.tasks = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
155	        self.tick = 0
156	        self.replay: list[dict[str, object]] = []
157	        self.map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
158	        self._map_sequence = 0
159	        self.paused_tasks: set[str] = set()
160	        # Consecutive per-robot waits caused purely by other robots:
161	        # robot_id -> {"blocked_by": [robot_id, ...], "ticks": int}.
162	        self._traffic_waits: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
163	        positions = [robot.position for robot in robots]
164	        if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
165	            raise ValueError("robots cannot share an initial position")
166	        if any(not grid.traversable(position) for position in positions):
167	            raise ValueError("robot starts outside traversable map space")
168	
169	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
170	    # Dynamic map edits
171	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
172	
173	    def modify_obstacles(
174	        self,
175	        added: Sequence[Position] = (),
176	        removed: Sequence[Position] = (),
177	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
178	        """Close and/or reopen cells without advancing the simulation.
179	
180	        The whole request is validated before anything changes: coordinates
181	        must be two plain integers (booleans are rejected), lie inside the
182	        map, no cell may appear in both lists, and newly added obstacles may
183	        not cover a robot's current cell. Duplicate coordinates inside one
184	        batch are processed once. Adding an existing obstacle or removing a
185	        traversable cell is a no-op. Invalid requests raise :class:`ValueError`
186	        and leave every part of the state untouched.
187	
188	        Assigned unfinished tasks keep their robot: routes are replanned
189	        against the new map, or, when a required point is unreachable, cleared
190	        while the task is suspended. No tick is recorded, no robot moves and no
191	        distance is accumulated.
192	        """
193	        add_cells = self._normalize_cells(added, "added")
194	        remove_cells = self._normalize_cells(removed, "removed")
195	        conflict = set(add_cells) & set(remove_cells)
196	        if conflict:
197	            cell = sorted(conflict)[0]
198	            raise ValueError(
199	                f"cell {list(cell)} is both added and removed in the same request"
200	            )
201	        occupied = {robot.position for robot in self.robots.values()}
202	        for cell in add_cells:
203	            if cell in occupied:
204	                raise ValueError(
205	                    f"cannot add obstacle at {list(cell)}: a robot currently occupies it"
206	                )
207	        return self._apply_map_change(add_cells, remove_cells)
208	
209	    def _normalize_cells(self, cells: Sequence[Position], label: str) -> list[Position]:
210	        if isinstance(cells, (str, bytes)) or not isinstance(cells, (list, tuple)):
211	            raise ValueError(f"{label} cells must be provided as a list of [x, y] pairs")
212	        seen: set[Position] = set()
213	        ordered: list[Position] = []
214	        for index, cell in enumerate(cells):
215	            position = _as_cell(cell, f"{label} cell {index}")
216	            if not self.grid.contains(position):
217	                raise ValueError(f"{label} cell {list(position)} lies outside the map")
218	            if position in seen:
219	                # Batch-internal duplicates are handled once, not rejected.
220	                continue
221	            seen.add(position)
222	            ordered.append(position)
223	        return ordered
224	
225	    def _apply_map_change(
226	        self, added: list[Position], removed: list[Position]
227	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
228	        obstacles = set(self.grid.obstacles)
229	        actual_added = [cell for cell in added if cell not in obstacles]
230	        obstacles.update(actual_added)
231	        actual_removed = [cell for cell in removed if cell in obstacles]
232	        obstacles.difference_update(actual_removed)
233	        if not actual_added and not actual_removed:
234	            return self._map_change_record(self._map_sequence, [], [])
235	
236	        # Everything below only runs once the batch was fully validated and is
237	        # known to change the map.
238	        self.grid = GridMap(self.grid.width, self.grid.height, frozenset(obstacles))
239	        self._map_sequence += 1
240	        record = self._map_change_record(self._map_sequence, actual_added, actual_removed)
241	        self.map_changes.append(copy.deepcopy(record))
242	        self.replay.append(copy.deepcopy(record))
243	        self._reroute_after_map_change()
244	        return copy.deepcopy(record)
245	
246	    def _map_change_record(
247	        self, sequence: int, added: list[Position], removed: list[Position]
248	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
249	        return {
250	            "type": "map_change",
251	            "tick": self.tick,
252	            "sequence": sequence,
253	            "added": [list(cell) for cell in added],
254	            "removed": [list(cell) for cell in removed],
255	        }
256	
257	    def _plan_route(
258	        self, robot: Robot, task: Task, start: Position | None = None
259	    ) -> list[Position] | None:
260	        """Shortest current->pickup->dropoff route, or None if unreachable.
261	
262	        *start* overrides the robot's current position, which is how sidestep
263	        candidates are evaluated without moving the robot first.
264	        """
265	        origin = robot.position if start is None else start
266	        try:
267	            if not task.picked_up:
268	                if origin == task.pickup:
269	                    to_pickup: list[Position] = []
270	                else:
271	                    to_pickup = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.pickup)
272	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
273	            else:
274	                # Goods are already on board: a reclosed pickup cell must not
275	                # pull the robot back.
276	                to_pickup = []
277	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.dropoff)
278	        except ValueError:
279	            return None
280	        return to_pickup + to_dropoff
281	
282	    def _reroute_after_map_change(self) -> None:
283	        for task in self.tasks.values():
284	            if task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
285	                continue
286	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
287	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
288	                continue
289	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
290	            if route is None:
291	                robot.route = []
292	                self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
293	            else:
294	                # Only the route is refreshed here; pickup/delivery are
295	                # confirmed at step start (or were already recorded).
296	                robot.route = route
297	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
298	
299	    def _recover_paused_tasks(self) -> None:
300	        """Resume tasks suspended by map unreachability where possible."""
301	        for task_id in sorted(self.paused_tasks):
302	            task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
303	            if task is None or task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
304	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
305	                continue
306	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
307	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
308	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
309	                continue
310	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
311	            if route is None:
312	                robot.route = []
313	                continue
314	            robot.route = route
315	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
316	            self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
317	
318	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
319	    # Traffic conflicts and yielding
320	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
321	
322	    def _route_cells(self, exclude_id: str) -> set[Position]:
323	        """Cells every robot except *exclude_id* still plans to drive through."""
324	        cells: set[Position] = set()
325	        for robot in self.robots.values():
326	            if robot.robot_id != exclude_id:
327	                cells.update(robot.route)
328	        return cells
329	
330	    def _idle_sidestep_cell(
331	        self,
332	        blocker: Robot,
333	        requester: Robot,
334	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
335	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
336	    ) -> Position | None:
337	        """Free side-cell an idle blocker can yield to, or None.
338	
339	        The target may not be the requester's own cell (that would swap the
340	        two robots within one tick) nor any cell another robot still plans to
341	        drive through, so the blocker never trades one blockage for another.
342	        """
343	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=blocker.robot_id)
344	        for cell in self.grid.neighbors(blocker.position):
345	            if cell == requester.position:
346	                continue
347	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved:
348	                continue
349	            if cell in on_routes:
350	                continue
351	            return cell
352	        return None
353	
354	    def _self_sidestep(
355	        self,
356	        robot: Robot,
357	        task: Task | None,
358	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
359	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
360	        already_moved: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
361	    ) -> tuple[Position, list[Position]] | None:
362	        """Best side cell plus replanned route for a blocked robot, or None.
363	
364	        Only cells off every other robot's planned route qualify, and only if
365	        the task remains reachable from there. A candidate that merely retreats
366	        along the corridor only to face the very same blocker again on the next
367	        tick is rejected too: such a move records mileage and gets undone
368	        forever instead of making progress, even when more empty cells stretch
369	        out behind the robot. Candidates are ranked by replanned route length
370	        with the deterministic neighbor order (up, left, right, down) breaking
371	        ties. *already_moved* names robots that have used their one move of
372	        this tick and therefore cannot vacate a cell to resolve the block.
373	        """
374	        if task is None or task.completed:
375	            return None
376	        destination = robot.route[0]
377	        blocker_id = occupied.get(destination)
378	        if blocker_id is None:
379	            blocker_id = reserved.get(destination)
380	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=robot.robot_id)
381	        best: tuple[int, int, Position, list[Position]] | None = None
382	        for index, cell in enumerate(self.grid.neighbors(robot.position)):
383	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved or cell in on_routes:
384	                continue
385	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task, start=cell)
386	            if route is None:
387	                continue
388	            if (
389	                blocker_id is not None
390	                and blocker_id != robot.robot_id
391	                and self._is_bounceback_retreat(
392	                    robot, cell, route, blocker_id, occupied, reserved, already_moved
393	                )
394	            ):
395	                # The replanned route immediately returns through the cell the
396	                # robot is vacating and the blocker cannot use that opening to
397	                # leave: the move would be undone on the next tick.
398	                continue
399	            if best is None or (len(route), index) < (best[0], best[1]):
400	                best = (len(route), index, cell, route)
401	        if best is None:
402	            return None
403	        return best[2], best[3]

405	    def _is_bounceback_retreat(
406	        self,
407	        robot: Robot,
408	        side: Position,
409	        replanned: Sequence[Position],
410	        blocker_id: str,
411	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
412	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
413	        already_moved: frozenset[str],
414	    ) -> bool:
415	        """Whether stepping to *side* only sends the robot back to the block.
416	
417	        A retreat is futile when the replanned route leads straight back through
418	        the robot's current cell and still runs through the blocker's cell (so
419	        the side move is undone next tick with the same blocker ahead) while
420	        the blocker cannot leave its own cell through the gap that opens up.
421	        A route that bypasses the blocker entirely is a genuine detour and is
422	        never rejected here.
423	        """
424	        if not replanned or replanned[0] != robot.position:
425	            return False
426	        blocker = self.robots.get(blocker_id)
427	        if blocker is None or blocker.position not in replanned:
428	            return False
429	        # Hypothetical end-of-tick layout: the requester has vacated its cell
430	        # and stands on the candidate side cell.
431	        hyp_occupied = dict(occupied)
432	        del hyp_occupied[robot.position]
433	        hyp_occupied[side] = robot.robot_id
434	        # The requester only gets back onto its route by driving through these
435	        # cells, so a blocker may only "leave" by driving on, never by parking
436	        # on the replanned route. The requester cannot make a second move
437	        # within this tick, and neither can a robot that already moved.
438	        blocked_path = frozenset(replanned)
439	        return not self._can_vacate(
440	            blocker,
441	            robot,
442	            hyp_occupied,
443	            reserved,
444	            frozenset({robot.robot_id}) | already_moved,
445	            blocked_path,
446	        )
447	
448	    def _can_vacate(
449	        self,
450	        blocker: Robot,
451	        requester: Robot,
452	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
453	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
454	        checking: frozenset[str],
455	        blocked_path: frozenset[Position],
456	    ) -> bool:
457	        """Whether *blocker* can leave its cell this tick in the given layout.
458	
459	        An idle blocker leaves only by yielding onto a safe side cell for the
460	        requesting robot; a busy blocker leaves by driving onto its next
461	        waypoint (possibly following a chain of robots that all move this tick)
462	        or by sidestepping onto a free adjacent cell itself. Robots paused by
463	        map unreachability never move. *checking* names robots whose leave
464	        check is already on the call stack, so a cyclic dependency (a head-on
465	        deadlock, or the requester itself) is not assumed resolvable.
466	        *blocked_path* holds the cells the retreating requester must drive back
467	        through: another robot parking there only moves the blockage, so such
468	        sidesteps do not count as leaving (driving on along the cell on the
469	        blocker's own route does).
470	        """
471	        if blocker.robot_id in checking:
472	            return False
473	        task = self.tasks[blocker.task_id] if blocker.task_id is not None else None
474	        if task is not None and task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
475	            return False
476	        if task is not None and not blocker.route:
477	            # A busy robot with no route left only arrives/finishes this tick;
478	            # it never drives or sidesteps for anyone.
479	            return False
480	        if task is None:
481	            # Idle robots only ever move by yielding for a requester.
482	            side = self._idle_sidestep_cell(blocker, requester, occupied, reserved)
483	            return side is not None and side not in blocked_path
484	        if blocker.route:
485	            ahead = blocker.route[0]
486	            if (
487	                self.grid.traversable(ahead)
488	                and ahead not in occupied
489	                and ahead not in reserved
490	            ):
491	                return True
492	            occupant_id = occupied.get(ahead) or reserved.get(ahead)
493	            if (
494	                occupant_id is not None
495	                and occupant_id != blocker.robot_id
496	                and occupant_id not in checking
497	            ):
498	                # The blocker could follow the robot ahead once that robot
499	                # vacates its cell this same tick.
500	                if self._can_vacate(
501	                    self.robots[occupant_id],
502	                    requester,
503	                    occupied,
504	                    reserved,
505	                    checking | {blocker.robot_id},
506	                    blocked_path,
507	                ):
508	                    return True
509	        # Otherwise the blocker might sidestep onto a free side cell itself,
510	        # but not onto a cell the retreating requester still has to use.
511	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=blocker.robot_id)
512	        for side_cell in self.grid.neighbors(blocker.position):
513	            if (
514	                side_cell in occupied
515	                or side_cell in reserved
516	                or side_cell in on_routes
517	                or side_cell in blocked_path
518	            ):
519	                continue
520	            if self._plan_route(blocker, task, start=side_cell) is not None:
521	                return True
522	        return False
523	
524	    def _update_traffic_waits(self, blocked_by: dict[str, str]) -> None:
525	        """Accumulate consecutive waits; any other outcome resets the counter."""
526	        for robot_id in list(self._traffic_waits):
527	            if robot_id not in blocked_by:
528	                del self._traffic_waits[robot_id]
529	        for robot_id, blocker_id in blocked_by.items():
530	            entry = self._traffic_waits.get(robot_id)
531	            if entry is None:
532	                self._traffic_waits[robot_id] = {"blocked_by": [blocker_id], "ticks": 1}
533	            else:
534	                entry["blocked_by"] = [blocker_id]
535	                entry["ticks"] = int(entry["ticks"]) + 1
536	
537	    def _traffic_wait_report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
538	        return [
539	            {
540	                "robot_id": robot_id,
541	                "blocked_by": list(entry["blocked_by"]),
542	                "ticks": entry["ticks"],
543	            }
544	            for robot_id, entry in sorted(self._traffic_waits.items())
545	        ]

551	    def assign_tasks(self) -> None:
552	        """Assign pending tasks to the nearest idle robot using stable tie breaks."""
553	        pending = [task for task in self.tasks.values() if task.assigned_robot is None]
554	        for task in sorted(pending, key=lambda item: item.task_id):
555	            choices: list[tuple[int, str, list[tuple[int, int]]]] = []
556	            for robot in self.robots.values():
557	                if not robot.idle:
558	                    continue
559	                try:
560	                    route = shortest_path(self.grid, robot.position, task.pickup)
561	                    route += shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
562	                except ValueError:
563	                    continue
564	                choices.append((len(route), robot.robot_id, route))
565	            if not choices:
566	                # No robot can reach this task yet; it keeps waiting and does
567	                # not block assignment of other tasks.
568	                continue
569	            _, robot_id, route = min(choices)
570	            robot = self.robots[robot_id]
571	            robot.task_id = task.task_id
572	            robot.route = route
573	            task.assigned_robot = robot_id
574	
575	    def _confirm_pickups(self) -> None:
576	        """A robot starting a tick on its pickup point collects first."""
577	        for robot in self.robots.values():
578	            if robot.task_id is None:
579	                continue
580	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
581	            if not task.completed and not task.picked_up and robot.position == task.pickup:
582	                task.picked_up = True
583	
584	    def step(self) -> dict[str, object]:
585	        self._confirm_pickups()
586	        self._recover_paused_tasks()
587	        self.assign_tasks()
588	        # A robot assigned while already standing on the pickup cell collects
589	        # immediately instead of driving off without the goods.
590	        self._confirm_pickups()
591	        occupied = {robot.position: robot.robot_id for robot in self.robots.values()}
592	        reserved: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
593	        moved: list[str] = []
594	        moved_ids: set[str] = set()
595	        blocked_by: dict[str, str] = {}
596	
597	        def relocate(robot: Robot, destination: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
598	            del occupied[robot.position]
599	            robot.position = destination
600	            robot.distance_travelled += 1
601	            occupied[destination] = robot.robot_id
602	            reserved[destination] = robot.robot_id
603	            moved.append(robot.robot_id)
604	            moved_ids.add(robot.robot_id)
605	
606	        for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id):
607	            if robot.robot_id in moved_ids:
608	                # Already yielded this tick at another robot's request.
609	                continue
610	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id] if robot.task_id is not None else None
611	            if task is not None and task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
612	                # Paused by map unreachability: stays put, never yields.
613	                continue
614	            if not robot.route:
615	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
616	                continue
617	            destination = robot.route[0]
618	            if not self.grid.traversable(destination):
619	                # Defensive: routes are normally replanned on every map edit.
620	                if task is not None and not task.completed:
621	                    route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
622	                    if route is None:
623	                        robot.route = []
624	                        self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
625	                    else:
626	                        robot.route = route
627	                continue
628	            blocker_id = occupied.get(destination)
629	            if blocker_id is None:
630	                blocker_id = reserved.get(destination)
631	            if blocker_id is None or blocker_id == robot.robot_id:
632	                relocate(robot, destination)
633	                robot.route.pop(0)
634	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
635	                continue
636	            # Another robot is in the way; this is distinct from a
637	            # map-unreachability pause and the task stays active.
638	            blocker = self.robots[blocker_id]
639	            if blocker_id not in moved_ids:
640	                if blocker.task_id is None:
641	                    # Idle blocker: ask it to yield onto a free side cell,
642	                    # then take over the cell it vacated.
643	                    side = self._idle_sidestep_cell(blocker, robot, occupied, reserved)
644	                    if side is not None:
645	                        relocate(blocker, side)
646	                        relocate(robot, destination)
647	                        robot.route.pop(0)
648	                        self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
649	                        continue
650	                elif blocker.route:
651	                    ahead = blocker.route[0]
652	                    if (
653	                        self.grid.traversable(ahead)
654	                        and ahead not in occupied
655	                        and ahead not in reserved
656	                    ):
657	                        # The blocker is expected to drive on within this
658	                        # tick, so waiting one tick is cheaper than detouring.
659	                        blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
660	                        continue
661	            # The blocker cannot or will not move this tick: try to sidestep
662	            # onto a free adjacent cell and replan from there.
663	            side = self._self_sidestep(
664	                robot, task, occupied, reserved, frozenset(moved_ids)
665	            )
666	            if side is not None:
667	                cell, route = side
668	                relocate(robot, cell)
669	                robot.route = route
670	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
671	                continue
672	            blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
673	        self._update_traffic_waits(blocked_by)
674	        self.tick += 1
675	        event: dict[str, object] = {
676	            "type": "tick",
677	            "tick": self.tick,
678	            "moved": moved,
679	            "robots": {robot_id: list(robot.position) for robot_id, robot in sorted(self.robots.items())},
680	            "completed": sorted(task.task_id for task in self.tasks.values() if task.completed),
681	        }
682	        self.replay.append(event)
683	        return event
684	
685	    def _finish_if_arrived(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
686	        if robot.task_id is None:
687	            return
688	        task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
689	        if task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
690	            return
691	        if robot.position == task.pickup:
692	            task.picked_up = True
693	        if task.picked_up and robot.position == task.dropoff and not robot.route:
694	            task.completed = True
695	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
696	            robot.task_id = None
697

699	        completed = sum(task.completed for task in self.tasks.values())
700	        return {
701	            "ticks": self.tick,
702	            "tasks_total": len(self.tasks),
703	            "tasks_completed": completed,
704	            "tasks_paused": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
705	            "completion_ratio": completed / len(self.tasks) if self.tasks else 1.0,
706	            "distance_total": sum(robot.distance_travelled for robot in self.robots.values()),
707	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
708	        }

738	    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
739	        """Write the simulator state to *path* without changing this instance.
740	
741	        The write is atomic: an existing destination keeps either its complete
742	        old contents or the complete new contents, and a brand-new destination
743	        is either fully created or left absent. Filesystem or permission errors
744	        raise :class:`OSError`.
745	        """
746	        document = {
747	            "version": CHECKPOINT_VERSION,
748	            "grid": {
749	                "width": self.grid.width,
750	                "height": self.grid.height,
751	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.grid.obstacles)],
752	            },
753	            "base_grid": {
754	                "width": self.base_grid.width,
755	                "height": self.base_grid.height,
756	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.base_grid.obstacles)],
757	            },
758	            "tick": self.tick,
759	            "robots": [
760	                {
761	                    "robot_id": robot.robot_id,
762	                    "position": list(robot.position),
763	                    "route": [list(cell) for cell in robot.route],
764	                    "task_id": robot.task_id,
765	                    "distance_travelled": robot.distance_travelled,
766	                }
767	                for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id)
768	            ],
769	            "tasks": [
770	                {
771	                    "task_id": task.task_id,
772	                    "pickup": list(task.pickup),
773	                    "dropoff": list(task.dropoff),
774	                    "assigned_robot": task.assigned_robot,
775	                    "picked_up": task.picked_up,
776	                    "completed": task.completed,
777	                }
778	                for task in sorted(self.tasks.values(), key=lambda item: item.task_id)
779	            ],
780	            "replay": copy.deepcopy(self.replay),
781	            "map_changes": copy.deepcopy(self.map_changes),
782	            "paused_tasks": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
783	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
784	        }
785	        payload = (json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
786	
787	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(os.fspath(path))) or os.curdir
788	        fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".checkpoint-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
789	        try:
790	            handle = os.fdopen(fd, "wb")
791	            try:
792	                handle.write(payload)
793	                handle.flush()
794	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
795	            finally:
796	                handle.close()
797	            os.replace(tmp_name, path)
798	            self._fsync_directory(directory)
799	        except BaseException:
800	            # After a successful replace the temp name is already gone.
801	            try:
802	                os.unlink(tmp_name)
803	            except OSError:
804	                pass
805	            raise
806	
807	    @staticmethod
808	    def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
809	        try:
810	            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
811	        except OSError:
812	            return
813	        try:
814	            os.fsync(dir_fd)
815	        except OSError:
816	            pass
817	        finally:
818	            os.close(dir_fd)

820	    @classmethod
821	    def load_checkpoint(cls, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> FleetSimulator:
822	        """Load an independent simulator instance from *path*.
823	
824	        The returned simulator shares no mutable state with the file or any
825	        other loaded instance. Invalid checkpoint content raises
826	        :class:`ValueError` explaining the reason; read/permission failures
827	        propagate as :class:`OSError`.
828	        """
829	        try:
830	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
831	                text = handle.read()
832	        except OSError:
833	            raise
834	        try:
835	            data = json.loads(text)
836	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
837	            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint is not valid JSON: {exc.msg}") from exc
838	        return cls._from_checkpoint(data)

840	    @classmethod
841	    def _from_checkpoint(cls, data: object) -> FleetSimulator:
842	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
843	            raise ValueError("checkpoint root must be a JSON object")
844	
845	        version = data.get("version")
846	        if not _is_int(version):
847	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'version' must be an integer")
848	        if version not in _SUPPORTED_VERSIONS:
849	            raise ValueError(
850	                f"unsupported checkpoint version {version}; supported versions: "
851	                f"{sorted(_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS)}"
852	            )
853	
854	        grid = cls._load_grid(data)
855	        tick = cls._load_tick(data)
856	        robot_records, task_records = cls._load_entities(data)
857	
858	        map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
859	        paused: set[str] = set()
860	        if version == 1:
861	            replay = cls._load_legacy_replay(data)
862	            base_grid = grid
863	        else:
864	            replay = cls._load_replay(data)
865	            map_changes = cls._load_map_changes(data)
866	            paused = cls._load_paused_tasks(data)
867	            base_grid = cls._load_base_grid(data)
868	            if (base_grid.width, base_grid.height) != (grid.width, grid.height):
869	                raise ValueError("base grid dimensions must match the current grid")
870	            cls._validate_map_history(base_grid, grid, map_changes)
871	
872	        robots: list[Robot] = []
873	        for record in robot_records:
874	            position = _as_pair(record["position"], f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position")
875	            if not grid.traversable(position):
876	                raise ValueError(
877	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position {list(position)} is outside "
878	                    "the map or inside an obstacle"
879	                )
880	            route: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
881	            previous = position
882	            for index, cell in enumerate(record["route"]):
883	                waypoint = _as_pair(
884	                    cell, f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {index}"
885	                )
886	                if not grid.traversable(waypoint):
887	                    raise ValueError(
888	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {list(waypoint)} is "
889	                        "outside the map or inside an obstacle"
890	                    )
891	                if abs(waypoint[0] - previous[0]) + abs(waypoint[1] - previous[1]) != 1:
892	                    raise ValueError(
893	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route moves non-adjacently from "
894	                        f"{list(previous)} to {list(waypoint)}"
895	                    )
896	                route.append(waypoint)
897	                previous = waypoint
898	            distance = record["distance_travelled"]
899	            if not _is_int(distance) or distance < 0:
900	                raise ValueError(
901	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} distance_travelled must be a "
902	                    "non-negative integer"
903	                )
904	            robots.append(Robot(record["robot_id"], position, route, record["task_id"], distance))
905	
906	        tasks: list[Task] = []
907	        for record in task_records:
908	            pickup = _as_pair(record["pickup"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} pickup")
909	            dropoff = _as_pair(record["dropoff"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} dropoff")
910	            tasks.append(
911	                Task(
912	                    record["task_id"],
913	                    pickup,
914	                    dropoff,
915	                    record["assigned_robot"],
916	                    record["picked_up"],
917	                    record["completed"],
918	                )
919	            )
920	
921	        robot_by_id = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
922	        task_by_id = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
923	
924	        for robot in robots:
925	            if robot.task_id is not None:
926	                task = task_by_id.get(robot.task_id)
927	                if task is None:
928	                    raise ValueError(
929	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes unknown task {robot.task_id!r}"
930	                    )
931	                if task.completed:
932	                    raise ValueError(
933	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} that is "
934	                        "already completed"
935	                    )
936	                if task.assigned_robot != robot.robot_id:
937	                    raise ValueError(
938	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} but the "
939	                        f"task is assigned to {task.assigned_robot!r}"
940	                    )
941	        for task in tasks:
942	            if task.completed and not task.picked_up:
943	                raise ValueError(f"task {task.task_id!r} is completed but never picked up")
944	            if task.picked_up and task.assigned_robot is None:
945	                raise ValueError(
946	                    f"task {task.task_id!r} is picked up but has no assigned robot"
947	                )
948	            # Completed tasks retain historical ownership; their robots are free
949	            # to take new work, so the mutual binding only holds while a task is

1132	    @classmethod
1133	    def _load_map_changes(cls, data: Mapping[str, object]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
1134	        raw = cls._require_field(data, "map_changes")
1135	        if not isinstance(raw, list):
1136	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'map_changes' must be a list")
1137	        changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
1138	        last_tick = -1
1139	        last_sequence = 0
1140	        for index, frame in enumerate(raw):
1141	            context = f"map change {index}"
1142	            if not isinstance(frame, dict):
1143	                raise ValueError(f"{context} must be an object")
1144	            tick = frame.get("tick")
1145	            sequence = frame.get("sequence")
1146	            if not _is_int(tick) or tick < 0:
1147	                raise ValueError(f"{context} field 'tick' must be a non-negative integer")
1148	            if not _is_int(sequence) or sequence <= 0:
1149	                raise ValueError(f"{context} field 'sequence' must be a positive integer")
1150	            if sequence != index + 1:
1151	                raise ValueError(
1152	                    f"map change sequences must run consecutively from 1; change {index} "
1153	                    f"has sequence {sequence}, expected {index + 1}"
1154	                )
1155	            if tick < last_tick:
1156	                raise ValueError(
1157	                    f"{context} tick {tick} is earlier than a preceding map change"
1158	                )
1159	            if tick == last_tick and sequence != last_sequence + 1:
1160	                raise ValueError(f"{context} breaks consecutive sequencing at tick {tick}")
1161	            added = cls._load_change_cells(frame.get("added"), context, "added")
1162	            removed = cls._load_change_cells(frame.get("removed"), context, "removed")
1163	            if not added and not removed:
1164	                raise ValueError(f"{context} contains no actual obstacle changes")
1165	            overlap = set(added) & set(removed)
1166	            if overlap:
1167	                cell = sorted(overlap)[0]
1168	                raise ValueError(
1169	                    f"{context} adds and removes the same cell {list(cell)}"
1170	                )
1171	            changes.append(
1172	                {
1173	                    "type": "map_change",
1174	                    "tick": tick,
1175	                    "sequence": sequence,
1176	                    "added": [list(cell) for cell in added],
1177	                    "removed": [list(cell) for cell in removed],
1178	                }
1179	            )
1180	            last_tick = tick
1181	            last_sequence = sequence
1182	        return changes

1184	    @classmethod
1185	    def _validate_map_history(
1186	        cls,
1187	        base_grid: GridMap,
1188	        saved_grid: GridMap,
1189	        changes: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
1190	    ) -> None:
1191	        obstacles = set(base_grid.obstacles)
1192	        width, height = saved_grid.width, saved_grid.height
1193	        for frame in changes:
1194	            for key in ("added", "removed"):
1195	                for cell in frame[key]:
1196	                    x, y = cell
1197	                    if not (0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height):
1198	                        raise ValueError(
1199	                            f"map change {frame['sequence']} cell {list(cell)} lies "
1200	                            "outside the map"
1201	                        )
1202	            added = {tuple(cell) for cell in frame["added"]}
1203	            removed = {tuple(cell) for cell in frame["removed"]}
1204	            for cell in added:
1205	                if cell in obstacles:
1206	                    raise ValueError(
1207	                        f"map change {frame['sequence']} adds obstacle {list(cell)} "
1208	                        "that is already present according to the history"
1209	                    )
1210	            for cell in removed:
1211	                if cell not in obstacles:
1212	                    raise ValueError(
1213	                        f"map change {frame['sequence']} removes obstacle {list(cell)} "
1214	                        "that is absent according to the history"
1215	                    )
1216	            obstacles |= added
1217	            obstacles -= removed
1218	        if obstacles != set(saved_grid.obstacles):
1219	            raise ValueError(
1220	                "the map reproduced from 'map_changes' does not match the saved grid"
1221	            )

1268	            if robot_id in waits:

1270	            blocked_by = entry.get("blocked_by")

1272	                not isinstance(blocked_by, list)

1278	                )

1280	                raise ValueError(f"{context} field 'blocked_by' contains duplicates")
1281	            for blocker_id in blocked_by:

1284	                if blocker_id not in robot_by_id:
